_note: Every magnitude here was set by tools/diplomacy_probe.gd BEFORE this file existed, not tuned after. The two numbers that decided them: an offset of 0.075 moves a bloc's approval target exactly 3.0 points, which is poll_noise.gd's NOISE_MAX_PCT; and an offset applied to fewer than six blocs never moves overall_approval_pct past that noise floor, so a split price is legible on the polling panel's per-bloc rows and nowhere else. See docs/diplomacy-model.md.

actions.name: State Visit
actions.summary: A formal visit, photographed and reciprocated. Costs nothing at home and buys a little goodwill abroad -- and it is the one act that puts the two leaders in one room, opening the window in which the treaty-class verbs below can be used.

actions.name: Bilateral Treaty
actions.summary: A standing agreement, only negotiable with a partner already well disposed and recently met. Business welcomes it; organised labour reads it as an opening to competition.

actions.name: Settle the Dispute
actions.summary: Concede the long-running bilateral quarrel outright, in person -- it cannot be done down a telephone line. The relationship transforms; at home every bloc reads it as a climbdown.
